request.texture_prompt: Western fence lizard (Sceloporus occidentalis), a male. Back grey-brown to dark brown with a row of wavy black chevron blotches down each side of the spine and a pale buff stripe along each side of the back; flanks brown with fine dark speckles; tail grey-brown with dark bands fading toward the tip. Belly pale grey with a large vivid cobalt-blue patch edged in black on each side of the belly; throat pale with two bright blue patches; underside of the legs yellow-orange; toes grey-brown. Keeled spiny scales, matte, no shine. Even diffuse light, no baked shadows or highlights.
